Joias artesanais da Grécia Cada peça de joalharia é entregue numa elegante caixa de presente com um saco de papel. A História das Joias A libélula é um símbolo intemporal de força e resiliência, utilizado como inspiração para joias desde a antiguidade. Este design delicado e elegante ganha uma nova vida na coleção Libélula de Emmanuela Alevizopoulou, que combina o simbolismo clássico com as tendências da moda contemporânea. Um motivo adorado que volta a estar na moda e o convida a expressar a sua personalidade dinâmica. Como usar Este broche é o acessório perfeito para dar um toque único ao seu look. Use-o num blusão, casaco, vestido ou bolsa para uma transformação instantânea. Para um impacto ainda maior, combine-o com o anel de libélula prateado ou com os brincos de libélula prateados da mesma coleção. É também o presente perfeito para quem aprecia joias artesanais originais e o seu significado simbólico. Uma peça que agrada a mulheres e homens dinâmicos e elegantes que adoram destacar-se.

item.g:title: Cuff earring with chains - banhado a ouro rosa / Apenas
item.g:description: A modern ear cuff that combines the delicacy of silver with the dynamics of chains. A piece of jewelry that stands out, embraces your ear with style and creates the impression of multiple piercings without the need for a single hole. This chain ear cuff allows you to experiment with your style, combine it with other earrings or wear it alone to steal the show. It is ideal for everyday use but also for special occasions, it easily adjusts to the ear and remains stable all day long.

item.g:title: Mother of Pearl Drop Earrings - Banhado a ouro / Madrepérola
item.g:description: Discover the delicate beauty of Mother of Pearl in dangle earrings that combine natural charm with the handcrafted craftsmanship of 925 silver. Features & Materials Material: High quality rhodium-plated 925 silver Stone: Mother of Pearl with alternative options in black onyx and lapis lazuli Type: Dangle earrings Gender: Female Weight: 10.6g (per pair) Dimensions: Width 10mm, Height 40mm Sale: Pair — price is for two pieces Available finishes: Gold Plated, Silver Properties: Hypoallergenic, non-tanning Does it require piercing: Yes The History of Jewelry Mother of Pearl, also known as mother of pearl, is a natural material that emits a unique iridescent glow. For centuries, it has symbolized protection, good luck and feminine energy. Each Mother of Pearl bead is unique, with its own natural variation of colors ranging from white to soft iridescent tones. Combined with rhodium-plated 925 silver, it creates a piece of jewelry that reflects natural elegance and a modern approach. How to wear them Mother of Pearl drop earrings are perfect for completing both everyday and evening looks. Pair them with a white shirt for a minimal chic look or with a dress for a more impressive style. The iridescent finish of Mother of Pearl reflects light in a unique way, adding shine to your face. For a layered look, pair them with ear cuffs or simply stud them in the second piercing. Also available in versions with black onyx or lapis lazuli, you can create a complete set or wear them separately depending on your mood. They are an ideal gift for any woman who appreciates handmade art and natural materials, delivered in an elegant gift box with a paper bag.

This particular design is ideal for those who love the edge and rock aesthetic, while remaining elegant enough to be worn on formal occasions. Its light weight (just 2.1g) ensures comfort even in all-day wear, while the rhodium-plated finish makes it ideal even for the beach - it is not affected by seawater or the sun. Combine it with minimal clothes to highlight the jewelry, or with bold outfits for a total rocker vibe. The ideal gift for a woman with personality who knows what she wants and is not afraid to show it.

item.g:title: "Snake" cuff earring - Gold-plated - Ruby / Esquerda
item.g:description: An ear cuff that attracts attention with its original snake design that elegantly climbs your ear. The synthetic zircon adds shine and glamour, while the 925 silver ensures quality and durability. A statement piece of jewelry for women who are not afraid to stand out. Features & Materials Material: Solid 925 silver rhodium plated with synthetic zircon Dimensions: Width 10mm, height 43mm - ideal size for a strong impression Weight: 2.1g - ultra-light for comfortable all-day wear Sale: Single earring - wear it on one ear for an asymmetric style No Piercing: No pierced ear required - just place it on and it hugs the ear Availability: In various colors (silver, rose gold, gold) Properties: Hypoallergenic, non-tanning, resistant to daily use The History of Jewelry The snake is one of the most ancient symbols in human history, symbolizing transformation, renewal and eternal life. In ancient Greece, the snake was a symbol of the goddess of health Hygieia and was associated with healing and wisdom. In modern fashion, snake-patterned jewelry has become emblems of strength and feminine charm. This handmade ear cuff captures the elegance and mysterious beauty of the snake in a way that is both bold and elegant. Every detail of the design - from the scales to the curvature of the body - is meticulously crafted in our workshop in Greece. Why Ear Cuff? Ear cuffs have taken the fashion runways and social media by storm, and rightfully so! They offer the ability to create a striking look without the need for multiple piercings. This particular design is ideal for those who love the edge and rock aesthetic, while remaining elegant enough to be worn on formal occasions. Its light weight (just 2.1g) ensures comfort even in all-day wear, while the rhodium-plated finish makes it ideal even for the beach - it is not affected by seawater or the sun. Combine it with minimal clothes to highlight the jewelry, or with bold outfits for a total rocker vibe. The ideal gift for a woman with personality who knows what she wants and is not afraid to show it.

The synthetic zircon adds shine and glamour, while the 925 silver ensures quality and durability. A statement piece of jewelry for women who are not afraid to stand out. Features & Materials Material: Solid 925 silver rhodium plated with synthetic zircon Dimensions: Width 10mm, height 43mm - ideal size for a strong impression Weight: 2.1g - ultra-light for comfortable all-day wear Sale: Single earring - wear it on one ear for an asymmetric style No Piercing: No pierced ear required - just place it on and it hugs the ear Availability: In various colors (silver, rose gold, gold) Properties: Hypoallergenic, non-tanning, resistant to daily use The History of Jewelry The snake is one of the most ancient symbols in human history, symbolizing transformation, renewal and eternal life. In ancient Greece, the snake was a symbol of the goddess of health Hygieia and was associated with healing and wisdom. In modern fashion, snake-patterned jewelry has become emblems of strength and feminine charm. This handmade ear cuff captures the elegance and mysterious beauty of the snake in a way that is both bold and elegant. Every detail of the design - from the scales to the curvature of the body - is meticulously crafted in our workshop in Greece. Why Ear Cuff? Ear cuffs have taken the fashion runways and social media by storm, and rightfully so! They offer the ability to create a striking look without the need for multiple piercings. This particular design is ideal for those who love the edge and rock aesthetic, while remaining elegant enough to be worn on formal occasions. Its light weight (just 2.1g) ensures comfort even in all-day wear, while the rhodium-plated finish makes it ideal even for the beach - it is not affected by seawater or the sun. Combine it with minimal clothes to highlight the jewelry, or with bold outfits for a total rocker vibe. The ideal gift for a woman with personality who knows what she wants and is not afraid to show it.

item.g:title: "Snake" jacket earrings with zircon - Gold Plated - Green
item.g:description: Discover the magic of ear jackets with snakes and sparkling zircons — a handmade piece of jewelry that transforms any look with its modern aesthetic and endless styling options. In ancient Greek mythology, snakes were associated with wisdom and eternal youth. These ear jackets capture the fluid movement of the snake, decorated with sparkling zircons that reflect the light like its scales. Their 55mm length makes them the perfect statement piece, ideal for evening looks or festival looks. Choose from 7 stunning colors — from classic silver with blue zircon to bold charcoal black with light blue. A unique gift for women who love high fashion accessories with symbolism and character.

item.g:title: Pin earrings with colorful zircons - Banhado a ouro / Multicolored
item.g:description: Handmade minimal ear pins that embrace your ears with colorful sparkles! These women's earrings made of 925 silver with colorful zircons create a modern aesthetic that flatters and impresses. Features & Materials Gender: Female Type: Earring (ear pins) Material: 925 Silver Stones: Multicolored zircons Weight: 2.7g (per pair) Dimensions: Height 7 mm, Width 20 mm Finishes: Silver, Gold Plated Properties: Rhodium-plated, hypoallergenic Piercing: Requires ear piercing Sale: Pair — price is for two pieces The Magic of Colorful Zircons Colorful zircons symbolize joy, creativity and the diversity of life. Each color brings its own energy: blue calmness, pink tenderness, green rebirth. These ear pins are a small rainbow that nestles in your ears, bringing light and optimism to your everyday life. How to Wear Them Ear pins have a unique way of wearing that gives them a unique style: you pass the pin through your ear hole like a classic earring, lift it so that it nestles in the flap and lightly press the plate behind the ear to secure it. No clasp needed — they stay firmly in place! Their minimal line makes them ideal for everyday use, while the multi-colored zircons add the necessary shine for evening looks. They are perfectly combined with other small studs or hoops for a layered look. They are also an original gift for women who love modern, discreet jewelry with character. The feminine vibe they offer is undeniable!

item.g:description: Discover the magic of ear pins that climb into your ear with elegance! Handmade earrings made of 925 silver with zircon, which create the illusion of multiple piercings without additional holes. The simple lines and minimal design, combined with the shiny zircons, create a piece of jewelry that balances between simplicity and shine. Ideal for women who love to impress in an elegant and sophisticated way. How to wear them Pin earrings are incredibly easy to use! You pass the base through your ear hole like a regular earring, then lift them up so they nestle in the flap and lightly press the plate behind the ear for stability. No clasp is needed and they stay in place all day long! Zircon ear pins pair perfectly with small studs or minimalist hoops for a layered look. They are the ideal gift for any woman looking for something different — from everyday looks to special occasions. They create the illusion of multiple piercings without additional holes, flattering every ear type in a feminine and elegant way.

Features & Materials Material: High quality 925 silver Type: Stud earrings Weight: 3.5g (per pair) Dimensions: Width 20mm, Height 35mm Finishes: Silver, Gold Plated, Rose Gold Plated, Charcoal Black with Ruthenium Coating Sale: Pair — price is for two pieces Gender: Female Piercing: Pierced ear required Packaging: Elegant gift box and separate paper bag The History of Jewelry The “fir branches” design is a natural reference to the winter season, the serenity of snowy forests and the eternal beauty of nature. The fir tree symbolizes endurance, longevity and renewal; it brings a sense of warmth and intimacy even on the coldest days. The fir branches, with their clean lines, create a minimal design that combines natural simplicity with fresh design, offering a jewel that stands out with discretion. How to wear them The “fir branch” stud earrings are ideal for everyday looks with a wintery mood, but also for special moments when you want to add a natural, original element. Combine them with simple clothes in earthy shades for a boho-chic look, or with more formal ensembles for a special touch. They are worn alone as a central piece of jewelry or combined with thin ear cuffs for a bolder layering. Available in four finishes, you can adapt them to your personal style and harmonize them with your other jewelry. They are also a great gift idea for women who love handmade, discreet but original jewelry with natural inspiration.

item.g:title: Diamond Necklace - Banhado a ouro / Larimar
item.g:description: A necklace that combines geometric elegance with natural beauty — consecutive rhombuses of 925 silver end in a magnificent larimar or moonstone stone, creating a unique boho chic piece of jewelry with character. Features & Materials Material: 925 silver with gold plating Available finishes: Silver, Gold Plated Stones: Larimar (blue/turquoise) or Moonstone (white) Pendant weight: 13.8g Pendant width: 40mm Pendant height: 155mm Chain length: 45cm Handmade in Greece Sold individually — price is for one piece No drilling required The History of Jewelry The rhombuses in the jewelry symbolize balance and harmony, while the larimar stone — known as the “stone of peace” — brings calm and positive energy. Moonstone, on the other hand, is associated with feminine energy and inner balance. The boho chic style of the jewelry reflects freedom, nature and authenticity — ideal for women who express themselves boldly and confidently. How to wear it This stunning diamond necklace is perfect for everyday or festive looks. Wear it alone over a solid-colored top to showcase the design and natural stone, or combine it with other minimal jewelry for a layered boho look. The 45cm chain places it in the perfect spot on the neck, while you can combine it with the matching diamond ring, ear cuff or diamond hoop earrings from the same collection for a complete ensemble. An ideal gift for women who love freedom, nature and jewelry with history. Delivered in an elegant gift box with a paper bag.

Features & Materials Material: Handmade solid 925 silver rhodium plated Weight: 2.40g – light and stable Dimensions: Width 14 mm, Height 12 mm Design: Twisted shell pattern that climbs the ear Properties: Hypoallergenic, non-tanning, water and sun resistant Available Colors: Silver, Gold, Pink Sale: Sold individually — price is for one earring Construction: Handmade in Greece with attention to detail The History of Jewelry The shell is a primordial symbol associated with the sea, rebirth and protection. In ancient mythology, the shell was associated with Aphrodite who was born from the foam of the sea. This ear cuff brings this marine energy into your everyday life – its twisted design is reminiscent of the natural patterns that the sea creates in its shells. It is a piece of jewelry that exudes boho elegance and natural beauty. Why Ear Cuff? This ear cuff is the ultimate fashion accessory for those who want to stand out without the need for piercing. It hugs your ear creating the illusion of multiple piercings, while firmly fitting the earlobe or top of the ear. Its special plating treatment makes it immune to factors that could affect silver – you can even wear it on the beach without worrying about seawater or the sun. Combine it with other jewelry for a multi-jewel style or wear it alone for a statement effect. The ideal gift for any occasion, it comes in an elegant gift box with a paper bag.

item.g:title: "Dragonfly" pendant necklace with pearls - Banhado a ouro
item.g:description: A unique handmade piece of jewelry that combines the grace of a dragonfly with the elegance of pearls. Hammered 925 silver creates an impressive pendant that stands out. Combine it with the matching dragonfly ring or the earrings from the collection for a complete and impressive look. The length of 43cm makes it ideal for everyday or evening looks. Choose the finish that suits you: classic silver, gold plated or romantic rose gold plated. It is also the perfect gift for women who love symbols of strength and original aesthetics. It is accompanied by a gift box and EMMANUELA paper bag.

item.g:title: Forged Necklace – Minimal & Bold - Prata / 40 cm.
item.g:description: A statement piece of jewelry that combines simplicity with strength of character. This hammered 925 silver necklace is handcrafted with passion, with each link individually crafted to create a unique play of light and texture. Features & Materials Material: 925 Sterling Silver, handmade Type: Pendant / Neck Chain Gender: Women's (also worn by men) Weight: 22g Processing: Forged finish Available colors: Silver, Gold, Black Sold: Single — price is for one piece The History of Jewelry The hammered finish is not just a processing technique — it is the signature of the handmade. Each stroke creates a unique texture that reflects light in a different way, giving the jewelry vitality and movement. The minimal & bold character of this chain represents the power of simplicity — a piece of jewelry that doesn't need to shout to steal the show. How to wear it This hammered chain is the perfect statement piece that can be worn alone for a bold, minimal look or paired with other thinner chains for layering. Its lightweight construction ensures all-day comfort, while its flexibility hugs the neck naturally. It pairs perfectly with casual or rock looks and adds character to any outfit. Available in different lengths and colors (silver, gold, black), you can adapt it to your style. An ideal gift for dynamic women who choose to stand out through their outfit.

item.g:title: Pendant - "Angel amulet" - Prata
item.g:description: Discover the handmade Angel amulet pendant – a delicate, artistic symbol of protection and love created exclusively in our workshop in Greece. Features & Materials Material: 925 Silver Finishes: Silver, 24K Gold Plated, Rose Gold Stones: Two turquoise zircons at the angel's feet Gender: Female Chain: 45cm Rolo chain included Properties: Hypoallergenic, nickel free Sale: Sold individually — price is for one piece Packaging: Beautiful eco-friendly gift packaging The History of Jewelry The guardian angel has been a symbol of protection, guidance, and divine grace since ancient times. The angelic abstract design of this pendant – with flowing lines, curved wings, and a modern artistic form – combines traditional symbolism with modern design. The two turquoise zircons at the angel’s feet add color and celestial symbolism, representing the healing and positive energy that angelic presence brings to our lives. How to wear it The Angel Amulet Pendant is as versatile as it is symbolic. Wear it alone on the accompanying Rolo chain for a minimal, elegant look that lets the artistic design shine. For a more dynamic look, layer it with other delicate necklaces of varying lengths. Choose from three finishes – classic silver, warm 24K gold-plated or romantic rose gold – to suit your style. It makes a perfect, meaningful gift for mothers, daughters, sisters and friends who need a symbol of strength and protection.

Features & Materials Material: Handmade solid 925 silver hypoallergenic Stones: Two high quality black zircons Weight: 1.5g – lightweight and comfortable for all-day use Design: Open fit without the need for a hole Available Finishes: Silver, Gold Plated, Rose Gold Plated Sale: Sold alone – the rest of the jewelry in the photos is styling Construction: Handmade in Greece The History of Jewelry Black zircon symbolizes inner strength, protection and mysterious charm. This minimal ear cuff is a modern take on classic elegance – where the dark color of the stones creates a striking contrast to the shine of silver. It is the ideal piece of jewelry for those who love discreet luxury and urban aesthetics. Why Ear Cuff? Ear cuffs have taken the fashion world by storm thanks to their versatility and bold style. No piercing required – simply place them in your ear and they fit securely and comfortably. They hug the ear naturally, offering a modern alternative to traditional earrings. The minimal design with black zircons makes them ideal for everyday wear or for evening looks that require elegance. Combine them with other silver or gold jewelry for a layered style, or wear them alone as a statement piece. They come in an elegant gift box, ready to give as a gift or keep for yourself.
